## How I tested it

- [ ] `cargo fmt --all -- --check`, `cargo clippy`, `cargo test --workspace`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` and `npm test`
- [ ] Tried it in the running app (Windows 10/11)

## Checklist

- [ ] No fake controls: anything not working is marked planned or unsupported in `catalog.ts`
- [ ] No new telemetry, accounts or network calls
- [ ] Docs and `CHANGELOG.md` updated if behavior or status changed
